descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-21 steps 1-3; TFA-92599 AC 4, AC 5 · “"Clinic" option removed from the switcher”. Mixed: stated part — One Hospital and one Nursing Home button, no Clinic, Quick Dictation only in Hospital, each context lists only its own custom template; our part — The /clinic redirect, a deep-link reload, and Settings write-back per context (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S02 Existing specs on main: switcher, Quick Dictation, /clinic redirect, deep-link reload, custom templates and Settings per context

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1e Quick Dictation is available in Hospital and absent in Nursing Home (UAT TC-21 step 1; UAT TC-04) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U5 No Clinic anywhere: absent from the context switcher and from the template picker (UAT TC-21; TFA-92599 AC 4; TFA-92599 AC 9) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U6 No data or template leakage between Hospital and Nursing Home. This covers lists, charts, the template picker, custom templates, account-wide screens (search, dashboard counts, Task Export, Inbox, mu … (UAT TC-21; TFA-92599 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Tim's suite at e02167f (navigation.spec.ts, template-isolation.spec.ts), each with its own fixture

When Run the four tests by title

Then Exactly one Hospital and one Nursing Home button, no Clinic; Quick Dictation only in Hospital; the setting persists; /clinic/* redirects to the selected context; a /rounding/<id> deep link survives a reload; each context lists only its own custom template, with one care-setting write per switch; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions in the specs (button counts, URL, settings:get appMode, toHaveCount(0) for the other context's template, modeWrites). The deep-link test proves only that the chart and session survive a reload, with no context check; S08/S11 do that.

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S02 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-21.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.
